headline: Rank Group Shares Drop 3% on £9 Million UK Duty Hike Impact
summary: Shares of Rank Group fell 3% after a UK machine games duty increase was estimated to cost the firm £9 million per year.
why: Rank Group is a prominent gaming and casino operator in the UK, highly exposed to changes in domestic gaming taxation.

impacts.name: Rank Group
impacts.why: A £9 million tax obligation reduces net income expectations, prompting investors to sell shares.

why_moved: Direct tax increases lower projected annual earnings, resulting in immediate share price devaluation.
